title: Use a local public file
summary: Files in public are served from the site root.

Explain the example for use a local public file

blocks.text: Files in public are served from the site root. Their folder name is not included in the public URL.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

items: The public directory is a source location, not part of the image URL.
Width and height reserve the image area, and alt describes the badge.

blocks.text: The page loads the actual local club.svg file and reserves its image space.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the file before using the path. /public/club.svg is not the correct public URL.
